name: isopod
description: Firecracker microVM sandboxes for coding agents: one disposable VM per action, with an egress boundary the guest cannot edit.

plugins.name: isopod
plugins.description: Run a command in a hardware-isolated microVM that is destroyed afterwards. Content-addressed stages fork an environment like a branch, and a default-deny egress allowlist enforced outside the guest returns a ledger of every destination the run tried. Needs Linux x86_64, /dev/kvm, and one `sudo isopod setup` — install isopod before enabling this plugin.
